meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 它会用 Microsoft Graph 帮你创建和配置 Entra 代理身份：Agent Identity Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal 以及每个实例的 Agent Identity，并按要求配置 fmi_path、OBO 等 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换。
howto.when: 当你需要创建代理身份蓝本或实例、配置代理运行时 OAuth 令牌交换，或排查 Agent ID 相关报错时，它会接管并按 Graph API 流程执行。

say.text: 帮我在当前租户创建一个 Agent Identity Blueprint
讲一下 fmi_path 两步换取令牌的流程
say.note: 给出两步交换与目标租户说明

howto.what_en: It provisions Entra agent identities through Microsoft Graph: Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities, and configures OAuth 2.0 token exchange such as fmi_path and OBO.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provision a Blueprint or BlueprintPrincipal, create per-instance Agent Identities, configure agent OAuth token exchange, or diagnose Agent ID errors.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint in my tenant
say_en.note: Builds the Blueprint via Graph, then the BlueprintPrincipal

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity for my-agent-instance-1 and grant User.Read.All
say_en.note: Grants are scoped per Agent Identity

say_en.text: Explain the two-step fmi_path token exchange
say_en.note: Covers both steps and the target tenant
